New acceptance:
  tests/v076_spatial_predicates_smoke.rex                         PASS

The v0.76 smoke proves:
  - real bundled GeoPackage POINT bytes decode through ST_X/ST_Y
  - ST_GEOMETRYTYPE returns POINT from embedded WKB
  - ST_SRID returns EPSG/SRID 27700
  - real sample address/minor ST_WITHIN join returns 0 rows (no fabricated link)
  - synthetic valid GPKG POINT within POLYGON is TRUE
  - boundary POINT is not ST_WITHIN but is ST_INTERSECTS
  - outside POINT is neither within nor intersects
  - POINT/POINT self intersection works
  - mismatched non-zero SRIDs fail explicitly
  - spatial JOIN uses generic INNER_PREDICATE_CHAIN
